The monetary benefit and credential entry are part of the presented offer, although the records do not establish that money was paid, credentials were collected, or what the linked destinations do.

opening.argument: The presentation is qualified as a no-investment opportunity rather than a demand for payment. The description repeatedly frames participation as available without investment, including “Play Game Win Paytm Cash Without Investment Any Time.” That matters because the material does not show a required deposit, paid access, or a guaranteed return. Its wording describes a promotional game opportunity and discusses earnings, but it does not promise that every viewer will profit or claim that the app is risk-free. The appropriate reading is an ordinary rewards promotion whose risks and actual results require viewer judgment, not deceptive certainty.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited title and description establish promotional wording, but they do not establish deception. “Win” describes the proposed game outcome, while “without investment” expressly distinguishes the offer from a pay-to-enter scheme. The reference also concedes that the records do not show payment, credential collection, or what the links do. Those missing facts are central to treating the promotion as fraudulent.

The title and description pair gameplay with winning and withdrawal, while the video describes people earning money. Nothing in these excerpts supplies a warning, qualification of likely losses, or proof that the promised reward exists.

opening.argument: The material can be read as an operational walkthrough of a mobile game, not as a disguised demand for money. The narration repeatedly explains how to use the app, including selecting an online mode, choosing players, and sending an invitation. The sampled screens show the Ludo 365 app, its online and local modes, a player/table-selection screen, and an “Add Friend” interface. Those are observable navigation steps. Even if the video mentions possible earnings, showing how an app works and how to access its functions is consistent with a tutorial or demonstration; it does not by itself prove that the creator is soliciting a deceptive payment.
